gaps_at_audit_time.gap: The Eggbev account is absent from Engine v3 account registration, so no Eggbev lane can be planned or executed.
No Eggbev creation/clone materializer exists to convert an approved request into a mode-specific manifest and reach validate/plan.
Smart Bidding report does not expose account 01; ROAS writes and economic reconciliation remain fail-closed.
Engine schema rejects clone_page_switch and no page selector or JSON/Page transformer exists.
No Eggbev watcher confirms first impression/spend after scheduled start; ACTIVE status alone does not prove delivery.
ADS ZERO RESULTS remains enabled and blocks ROAS writes until the approved activation transition.
Gateway runtime is alive but the cron subsystem reports gateway_running=false; automatic LEADS protection is not considered proven until a scheduled tick readback.
A durable rule to detect and retire stale Ares provenance after manager/external status changes is not implemented.
ROAS above threshold only keeps delivery; no approved budget scaling or winner expansion policy exists.
No approved arbitration rule exists when Meta Purchase ROAS and Smart Bidding ROI disagree or have different freshness.
Smart Bidding date payload uses UTC Z boundaries while decisions are ET; source semantics must be validated before economic automation.
The page-lead runner does not validate a source freshness timestamp; clone_page_switch explicitly requires stale pages to be ineligible.
An active ad with no insight row is treated as valid N/D and paused in Phase 2; Nicolas should confirm this includes true zero-delivery ads, not only rows returned with an empty ROAS field.
Creation from zero has no explicit operation-specific final status policy, although the engine default distinguishes technical PAUSED canary from future ACTIVE production.
Native rule ADS ON 1.1 remains HAS_ISSUES without a keep/disable/remove decision.
